quest.title: A New Day at the Lil' Fungi Playground
quest.description: After several days of travel and fun, you return to the Lil' Fungi Playground at Bayda Harbor, accompanied by your Fungi friends...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I could already hear Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy's cheerful steps from a distance. Looks like you really had a blast this time!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: You can tell they're having fun from that far away? I still can't read the emotions in our Fungi friends' footsteps...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Guess I've got a lot to learn... There's always more to learn!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, this trip really did feel different!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Running around with our Fungi friends, then coming back to the Lil' Fungi Playground, it feels like coming home to a nice meal after a long day of playing outside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about we take a photo together right now? Paimon remembers reading in The Steambird that many famous travel journals line up all the little snapshots from a trip in chronological order.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Now that Silver Companion mentions it, I've gotten so used to having these Fungi friends around all these years... We've never really taken a proper photo together...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Mmhmm! You two big shots really know how to wrap up an adventure nicely!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's use Bongo-Head's Kamera, set it on the tripod, and take a timed group photo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Once Haniyyah and Souka are less busy, we can all go out and have fun together like this again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Bongo-Head is really talented at taking photos!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon picked a few good shots and put them together with our group photo. Haniyyah and Souka can check them out too!

choices.text: Wow... you really thought of everything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, and... Paimon brought some souvenirs for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Here! The macarons you didn't get to try before!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Aww, I only said it in passing, and you actually remembered it?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Silver Companion... I'm so touched...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: To avoid troubling you like this in the future, I really need to fix my bad habits. I'll plan trips properly in advance... and not just on paper.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, when friends are hanging out and chatting freely, even offhand comments can show what's truly on your mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, back when we were taking photos in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: While you were watching the scenery with Bongo-Head, Paimon got a newsy to help out and gave her a little tip for the trouble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Paimon prepared your share too! Paimon wouldn't forget, hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon even reminded the newsy to go straight for your favorite flavor as soon as she got inside!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we've already tried almost every dessert in Fontaine, so Paimon's not sure how much of a surprise this will actually be...

choices.text: Anything Paimon picks out is bound to be delicious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Hehe... then Paimon will buy you treats more often!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Too bad there aren't any sweets made especially for our Fungi friends... How amazing would it be if we could cuddle up with them and enjoy a table full of delicious food!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: No need to worry about that. In the process of refining On Fungi Communities, I've been conducting foundational research on the food that Fungi enjoy.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: My goal is to identify ingredients that both Fungi and humans can eat, so our buddies don't have to live off every flavor of Marvelous Jelly all year long.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: One day, I'll find the ingredients that satisfy both human and Fungi tastes, and design delicious dishes we can all enjoy together!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: And when it comes to putting theory into practice, I'll be our master chef! Just in case Haniyyah ends up ruining our eleventh pot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like the day we sit in a circle and share a meal with our Fungi friends isn't far off, right?

choices.text: We'll be waiting for your good news, Haniyyah!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In that case, please do come back and visit the Lil' Fungi Playground when you get the chance. We, and all our Fungi friends, will always be here.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Who knows? The surprise might arrive even sooner than you expect.

choices.text: We can't wait for Souka's feast!
It's a treat you bought for me on your own. That makes it special!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then, we've shared a lovely journey with our Fungi friends...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's time to go back and meet up with Haniyyah and Souka!
